sample.default: We recruited {{n_total}} participants from {{location}} between {{start_date}} and {{end_date}}.
sample.large: We recruited {{n_total}} participants ({{n_male}} male, {{n_female}} female, {{n_other}} other) from {{location}}. The mean age was {{mean_age}} years (SD = {{sd_age}}, range: {{min_age}}-{{max_age}}).

lmtp.text: We used Longitudinal Modified Treatment Policies (LMTP) to estimate causal effects under {{shift_type}} shift interventions. The analysis was implemented using the lmtp package in R (version {{lmtp_version}}).

gcomp.text: We employed parametric g-computation to estimate the effect of {{exposure}} on {{outcome}} across {{n_timepoints}} time points.

regression.text: We used {{model_type}} regression to examine associations between {{predictors}} and {{outcome}}, adjusting for {{covariates}}.

multiple_imputation.text: Missing data were handled using multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE) with {{n_imputations}} imputations. The imputation model included {{imputation_vars}}.

complete_case.text: We conducted complete case analysis, including only participants with complete data on all variables (n = {{n_complete}}, {{pct_complete}}% of the original sample).
